current.text: He left the Nets and is now with the Lakers.
Yahoo lists him as questionable with a foot injury.
He reportedly bulked up to play power forward.
The Lakers preview projects Doncic, Reaves, Grimes, Thybulle and Kessler as starters, with LaRavia as another option. Williams is not in that group.
Experts disagree on his role. One mock draft said he might start for the Lakers. The Lakers preview a week later does not project him to start.
He is worth monitoring if he gets 30 minutes, but that seems unlikely.
Josh thinks his shooting upside could help him thrive next to Luka Doncic.
The Lakers have the second most back-to-backs in the league.
The expert warns that soft tissue injuries could become a problem for the Lakers with this many back-to-backs. That matters for a player with his hamstring history.
The Lakers play 3-4-3 games in our playoff weeks with the March 28 end date. That is in the bottom half of the league.

durable.text: He has had many hamstring injuries.
He is a solid, disruptive perimeter defender with high deflection and steal rates.
His offense has not developed enough to earn him a secure long-term rotation spot.

note: Do not draft him. Yahoo and ESPN both value him at 0 USD (ranks 271 and 223), well outside the 144 players our league drafts. His projected line is weak in PTS, REB and AST, and his steals (0.9) and low turnovers are not outliers. In the first weeks, check his foot (Yahoo Q), whether he starts over Grimes, Thybulle or LaRavia, and whether his minutes reach 30. Only then is he a waiver pickup for steals and threes.
